description: New releases of dayjs, left-pad, lodash and esbuild must be 7 days old before Renovate raises a pull request, so a compromised publish has time to be yanked.
internalChecksFilter strict enforces the delay instead of only reporting it: a pending release produces no pull request at all.
Security fixes are exempt via vulnerabilityAlerts, so a fix for the pinned vulnerable lodash 4.17.10 is raised immediately.

Emergency bypass for a human: set minimumReleaseAge to null in this file on a branch owned by a CODEOWNER of /renovate.json, or bump the dependency by hand in package.json and package-lock.json. Do not relax internalChecksFilter.
